claim: Where four campaign maps cut a floor only to change its light, the median step across the seam is 10 to 14.5 shades (E1M4 10, E3M1 12, E3M2 14, E3M5 14.5), though some seams step a shade or less (27 of E1M4's 107). Smaller steps vanish in Blood's dark, contrasty textures (facade tiles measured 2026-11-20 with bloodmap.shade_table at texel spreads of 12 to 34 at shade 0; not recounted).
evidence: knowledge/blood/findings/probes/lightstage_budget.py E1M4 E3M1 E3M2 E3M5: median seam steps 10, 12, 14, 14.5 over 107, 68, 72, 14 light-only seams (27, 14, 18, 4 of them at 1 shade or less); bloodmap/light_stage.py:591-596 (FLOOR_BAND 12) and :883-887 (WALL_BAND 14)
The owner, 2026-11-20: the usable range is roughly 0 to 40, and 40 is visibly dark.
an agent's note of 2026-11-21 that E3M1 has 41% of its room floor inside lamp pools is not re-measured
use: Cut light pieces only where the step is at least ~10 shades; lowering base light alone only darkens, contrast needs falloff from sources.
